name: Validate upstream runtime drift
prompt: Check the exact GitHub issue `Upstream runtime drift` and D:\codex-web-gpt-automation\upstream-runtime-policy.json. If no drift exists, report current and do nothing. If drift exists, act as the scheduled maintainer under AGENTS.md and mcp-update-guard: validate exact npm integrity, rebase hash-gated patches, run Oracle no-submission and DevSpace same-workspace open/read/read_chunk SHA gates, require reviewed PR and exact-commit Windows/macOS/Linux CI, then release and lifecycle-install only when all gates pass. Stable patch/minor all-gates success has standing approval. Major/breaking, permission/OAuth, patch conflict, failed/ambiguous gate, or unsafe restart requires explicit user authority. Never mutate projects/accounts, submit Pro, execute moving latest, or stop an active/uncertain Oracle run.
